name: Investment maths by hand
summary: Checks each watched investment property's record and price estimate, works out gross yield and cash flow from the buyer's assumptions, and records the result as a note on the property. Crons read and draft; nothing reaches the investor without a person.

covered_by.property-facts: draft (VaultRE property read, Domain price estimate read)
covered_by.comparable-sales: gap (no mapped comparables lookup; see gaps)
covered_by.cash-flow: draft (gross yield and cash flow from settings assumptions, noted on the property)
covered_by.scenario-compare: skill (the agent compares scenarios by hand and updates the assumptions)
covered_by.present-to-client: gap (no mapped sending platform; see gaps)

crons.name: property-facts
crons.summary: Read each watched property's record and its Domain price estimate (21:00 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: cash-flow-note
crons.summary: Work out gross yield and cash flow from the assumptions, and draft a note on the property record when they change.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a read, or a note on a property record inside VaultRE. Nothing here emails, enquires, or changes a status a customer or agent can see.

vaultre.covers: property read and property note (addPropertyNote: body, readOnly, type confirmed in the vendor spec)

domain.covers: price estimate read by propertyId; the response is stored as returned because its fields are not confirmed in the vendor page

gaps: Comparable sales: no mapped per-property comparables lookup. Domain's listings search is a POST that the kit classes as a write, so it is not a draft operation here. The price estimate is the only valuation read.

Domain price estimate response: the vendor page does not show the response fields (the OpenAPI spec was not downloaded), so the adapter stores the reply as returned and nothing reads named fields from it.

Present to investor: no mapped platform sends email or messages for this job. google-workspace and microsoft-365 have no mail or Sheets operations in the kit's ops files. Four-property shortlists go out by hand until a sending adapter is mapped.
Live operations: none. The only outward step (sending properties to the investor) has no mapped operation, so nothing is queued for approval.
CoreLogic RP Data: the pages supplied are market insight articles with no product or API docs, so it is not mapped.
Tax impact, yield and growth outlook, and scenario comparisons are judgment steps for the agent in SKILL.md, not crons.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox or trial account proves it. The VaultRE adapter needs a real account to confirm the property note type ID.
